facts.business: Gopal Snacks Limited manufactures and sells ethnic Indian snack products including namkeen, gathiya, wafers, snack pellets, extruder products, noodles, spices and flour across 13 states and 2 Union Territories through 6 manufacturing facilities.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter: Fire incident at Rajkot plant on December 11, 2024 causing significant damage to property, plant and equipment, inventory and other assets; no human casualties. Company has adequate insurance cover and claim lodged but claim receivable not accounted for in books.

key_risks: Revenue recognition risk due to significant estimation involved in discounts and rebates
Risk of revenue overstatement due to pressure to achieve performance targets
Fire incident at Rajkot plant causing significant asset damage and exceptional loss of Rs 471.85 million
